name: Sync Changelog
description: Update CHANGELOG.md based on commits since last release. LLM summarizes changes into human-readable entries.

variables.name: sinceTag
variables.description: Git tag to compare from (default: latest tag)

tasks.description: Get commits since last release tag

command.run: git log {{#if sinceTag}}{{sinceTag}}{{else}}$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo HEAD~20){{/if}}..HEAD --oneline --no-merges

tasks.description: Use LLM to categorize commits into changelog sections

prompt.template:
Categorize these commits into changelog sections:

```
{{commitList}}
```

Categories (use Keep a Changelog format):
- **Added** - New features
- **Changed** - Changes in existing functionality
- **Deprecated** - Soon-to-be removed features
- **Removed** - Removed features
- **Fixed** - Bug fixes
- **Security** - Vulnerability fixes

For each commit:
1. Determine which category it belongs to
2. Write a human-readable summary (not the commit message verbatim)
3. Group related commits together

Output as markdown.

Read CHANGELOG.md (create if doesn't exist).

Add a new section at the top for [Unreleased] with these changes:

{{categorizedChanges}}

Follow Keep a Changelog format:
- Each version is a heading
- Changes are categorized
- Links at bottom for version comparisons

Edit the file.
